title: fix(core): keep invalid API key stream errors terminal after AI SDK bump
why: Three lines in the core stream error retry processor decide whether auth errors are retried for every agent stream. Tiny diff, hot path.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,5 @@
+---
+'@mastra/core': patch
+---
+
+Fixed `isBadRequestError` retrying invalid API key errors. Newer OpenAI provider versions report `invalid_api_key` stream errors with status 400, so they were retried as bad requests instead of failing right away. Authorization errors now stay terminal.
